actions.rationale: Receive 2027-06 CORRA: overnight CORRA remains low versus a priced 2027 hiking cycle that post-FOMC CAD STIR catch-up has overbuilt relative to Canadian labor 38 and core near 2%.

events.invalidation: Canada labor/core re-accelerate or energy pass-through lifts 2027 CORRA implieds back toward the packet 2028 peak; Nov/Dec CORRA front contracts keep adding hike premium as BoC delivers the priced path.
events.rationale: Empty book earns official SOFR 3.85% ACT/360 (2026-09-17) on unused cash; deploying modest rates risk is justified where the priced Canada path overshoots fundamentals and multiple handoff seats (rate-dove, perma-bear, positioning-cynic) align on receive CORRA rather than fighting the split AONIA camp or NZ FX with missing NZ rates. Reject no-trade-skeptic flat-only on hurdle grounds because the Canada policy-path gap is a defined macro expression, not a re-trade of the >90% priced Fed hike. Reject vol-convexity (options unavailable), catalyst-junkie vs mean-reverter AONIA conflict, and hawk SOFR pay as the primary leg to avoid doubling US duration risk without a single locked US-CA STIR combo. Accept rate-dove CORRA_2027-06 as the cleanest paper-markable rates-first ticket; dollar-king USDCAD is consistent FX color but secondary to the STIR edge. On-demand fallback and CFTC gaps cap conviction, not direction.
events.thesis: Grind a singles/doubles Canada STIR receive: post-delivered Fed hike, MX CORRA still embeds a full BoC hiking cycle against soft labor and core-near-2% while SR3 forward context (4.32/4.58/4.755) is only the US leg reference, not cash accounting.
